description: A-4M c/n 14414, ex USMC BuNo 159473 (VMA-223, VMA-311), bought by the FAA August 1995 as a spares source for the A-4AR programme; restored at Río Cuarto in A-4AR scheme with the fictitious serial C-939 and erected in the plaza by the station in 2011. Reported July 2020 and October 2023.
